vulnerability_analysis: The contract has multiple issues: 1) The owner can be changed via storage slot manipulation since the contract uses standard Ownable pattern. 2) The marketing address can be changed by the owner to any address. 3) When swapAndLiquify is enabled and conditions are met, the contract swaps tokens for ETH and sends a portion to the marketing address. By combining these, an attacker can become owner, set marketing address to themselves, trigger a sell to cause token swap, and receive ETH.
attack_strategy: 1. Overwrite the owner storage slot to make attacker the owner. 2. Set marketing address to attacker's address. 3. Ensure swapAndLiquify is enabled (it's disabled by default, need to enable it). 4. Acquire some MiniDOGE tokens. 5. Sell tokens to trigger the swap mechanism which will send ETH to marketing address (attacker).
step_by_step_plan: 1. Use vm.store to overwrite storage slot 0 (owner) with attacker address. 2. Call setSwapAndLiquifyEnabled(true) as new owner. 3. Call setMarketingAddress(attacker). 4. Get some MiniDOGE tokens by buying from pair. 5. Sell tokens back to pair to trigger swap (need to meet conditions: contract token balance >= minimumTokensBeforeSwap and time interval passed). 6. Wait for swap to execute and receive ETH.
